title: CTO Job Description
body:
# Job Description: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

## Company: SUPAA
**Location:** Remote / San Francisco
**Role:** Chief Technology Officer

## About the Role
As the first engineering hire at SUPAA, you will partner directly with the CEO to build the foundation of our platform. You will be responsible for the technical vision, architecture, and initial implementation of our core products.

## Responsibilities
- Design and build the initial MVP and core architecture.
- Define the technical roadmap in alignment with business goals.
- Establish engineering best practices, including CI/CD, testing, and code reviews.
- Hire and lead a high-performing engineering team.
- Make key decisions on the tech stack and infrastructure.

## Requirements
- 8+ years of software engineering experience.
- Previous experience as a CTO, VP Engineering, or Founding Engineer at a high-growth startup.
- Deep expertise in full-stack development (preferably Node.js, TypeScript, and modern cloud infra).
- Strong leadership and communication skills.
- Passion for building innovative products from the ground up.

## What We Offer
- Founding team equity.
- Opportunity to shape the technical future of SUPAA.
- High autonomy and impact.
